newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DORTMUND ERUPTS WITH JOY AS BORUSSIA WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND ERUPTS WITH JOY AS BORUSSIA WIN.

text.p: The city of Dortmund launched into an ecstatic all-night party on Wednesday after Borussia Dortmund won the European Cup for the first time in their history.

Tens of thousands of fans who had packed into the city centre to watch the final on a giant video screen sang, danced, cheered and waved flags and scarves in the club colours of yellow and black after the final whistle blew.

"This means a lot for people because they identify with Borussia so strongly," Dortmund city council spokesman Carsten Hensel said. "The level of expectation was very high, even though they were playing Juventus."

Dortmund's win created a remarkable double for Germany's depressed Ruhr Valley industrial heartland as neighbours Schalke had claimed the UEFA Cup last week with victory over another top Italian team -- Internazionale.
Hensel said city centre traffic had ground to a standstill long before the end of the match as many of Dortmund's 600,000 residents rushed to join the party.

The fans leapt into the air and began singing the club anthem after Karlheinz Riedle put Borussia ahead. Riedle's second propelled them even higher and a huge sea of supporters began twirling their scarves.
A huge cheer also went up when Juventus had a goal disallowed and chants of "Fight Dortmund! Fight!" followed Alessandro Del Piero's strike which made the score 2-1.
When Lars Ricken's exquisite goal made Dortmund's win all but certain, the fans broke out in unbridled joy. Television pictures of the trophy were greeted with huge cheers.
"I'm crazily happy," yelled Tom Beckmann, an 18-year-old fan from the town of Bielefeld .
The main city centre party and other celebrations in bars and homes across Dortmund were likely to go on long into the night.
The city plans a huge welcome for its heroes on Thursday with a motorcade to be followed by a giant celebration at the Friedensplatz square where Wednesay's party took place.
